title: The brief for Thursday
do: Open Calendar, click Steering on Thursday, press Get the brief. The Prep section lands on the page; scroll to it.
offScript: That is outside what this demo can show. The six things it can do are listed in Settings, under Demo.

input.append:
## Prep

- No-show fees now has a date: end of October. Brasserie Lund was told at the [[meetings/{{date:2026-07-16}}-brasserie-lund-quarterly-review]] on 2026-07-16. [[people/asa-lindgren|Åsa]] has not heard it; her page stops at 2026-07-09 with "Q4". Say it first, before Marcus does.
- The [[tickets/jira/BOK-300]] stories are drafted, three with three checks each, for sprint planning on 2026-07-22. [[people/rebecca-holm|Rebecca]] gives an estimate after that, not a date before it.

Delivery since 2026-07-09:

- [[tickets/jira/GST-140]], table areas on the booking page, shipped on 2026-07-14.
- [[tickets/jira/PAY-210]], deposits, is still In Progress with no date.

Loose ends:

- [[people/henrik-dahl|Henrik]] owes a date for PAY-210, asked at the [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]]. Ask again in the room; it is the only thing that moves group bookings.

Landmines:

- [[tickets/jira/GST-77]], Google bookings, has been live since 2026-05-12 and sales has not been told in writing. Marcus still lists it as coming. One line to him closes it.
input.rationale: Four people in the room, and the record shows what each of them has not heard since 2026-07-09: Åsa the October date, Marcus that the Google button is live, and everyone that PAY-210 still has no date.

turns.text: The brief is on the steering page: what changed since 2026-07-09, what shipped, what Henrik owes, and what Marcus will raise. One thing to do before you walk in: tell [[people/asa-lindgren|Åsa]] the October date yourself, before Marcus does. Nothing waits and nothing was sent.
